events.label: Asian financial crisis hits Wall Street
events.why: After Hong Kong stocks crashed, the Dow posted its biggest one-day point drop to that date and circuit breakers halted trading.

events.label: Yen carry trade unwinds
events.why: Hedge funds dumped huge short-yen positions and the dollar fell sharply against the yen in a single day.

events.label: Nasdaq "Black Friday"
events.why: The Nasdaq plunged about 9.7% in one day as the dot-com bubble began to burst in earnest.

events.label: Surprise Fed rate cut
events.why: The Fed unexpectedly cut rates by 50 basis points between meetings.

events.label: Another Fed cut between meetings
events.why: The Fed cut rates by 50 basis points between scheduled meetings and stocks jumped.

events.label: Wall Street reopens after 9/11
events.why: The NYSE reopened after four days closed; the VIX and Treasury yields swung violently.

events.label: Fed cuts rates to 1%
events.why: The Fed lowered the federal funds rate to 1%, a record low at the time.

events.label: China revalues the yuan
events.why: The People's Bank of China dropped the dollar peg and the yuan rose about 2% against the dollar.

events.label: Shanghai crash sparks global selloff
events.why: Chinese stocks fell about 9% in one day, rattling global markets and sending the VIX higher.

events.label: Yen carry unwind and subprime panic
events.why: Subprime fears escalated and carry trades unwound: the yen jumped and US stocks swung wildly.

events.label: Emergency 75 bp Fed cut
events.why: After a global stock rout, the Fed cut rates by 75 basis points in an emergency move between meetings.

events.label: Bear Stearns sold
events.why: The Fed brokered a rescue sale of the collapsing Bear Stearns to JPMorgan.

events.label: Lehman Brothers collapses
events.why: Lehman filed for bankruptcy; the VIX spiked and Treasury yields plunged.

events.label: House rejects the TARP bailout
events.why: The US House voted down the $700 billion rescue plan and the S&P 500 fell about 8.8% in a day.

events.label: Coordinated global rescue rally
events.why: Several countries announced bank recapitalizations; stocks soared and the VIX eased.

events.label: Fed expands quantitative easing
events.why: The Fed announced purchases of long-term Treasuries and the 10-year yield dropped sharply in a day.

events.label: Greece cut to junk
events.why: S&P downgraded Greece to junk; the euro weakened and safe havens rallied.

events.label: First trading day after the US downgrade
events.why: S&P cut the US from AAA to AA+; stocks plunged on Monday while Treasuries rallied.

events.label: Swiss National Bank sets a euro floor
events.why: The SNB announced the euro would not fall below 1.20 francs; the franc plunged in a day.

events.label: Euro-zone crisis worsens
events.why: The Fed's "Operation Twist" plus European worries hammered risk assets worldwide.

events.label: Gold crash
events.why: Gold fell about 9% in a day, its biggest one-day drop in decades, and commodities broadly slid.

events.label: Fed lays out a tapering timeline
events.why: Stocks and bonds both sold off after the Fed meeting and the 10-year yield jumped.

events.label: OPEC refuses to cut output
events.why: After Thanksgiving, OPEC decided against a production cut and oil fell about 10% in a day.

events.label: Swiss National Bank drops the euro floor
events.why: The SNB suddenly scrapped its 1.20 floor; the franc soared in an instant, rippling through global currency markets.

events.label: Fed drops "patient" from its statement
events.why: A dovish Fed meeting sent the dollar sharply lower and the euro sharply higher.

events.label: China crash "Black Monday"
events.why: A Chinese stock rout dragged down global markets; the Dow was down more than 1,000 points at the open.

events.label: Negative rates and bank-stock panic
events.why: Global bank shares tumbled and money fled to safety; Treasury yields and the yen swung wildly.

events.label: Brexit referendum result
events.why: Leave won unexpectedly; sterling collapsed and safe-haven money poured into Treasuries and the yen.

events.label: Trump wins the election
events.why: Trump's surprise win set off the "Trump trade" in Treasury yields and US stocks the next day.

events.label: Volmageddon
events.why: The Dow fell 1,175 points in a day, the VIX nearly doubled, and short-volatility products collapsed.

events.label: Yield surge hammers stocks
events.why: The 10-year yield rose above 3.2% and the S&P 500 fell about 3.3% in a day.

events.label: Christmas Eve selloff
events.why: A Fed hike and shutdown fears pushed the S&P 500 to the brink of a bear market before it bounced.

events.label: Powell pivots
events.why: Powell said the Fed would be "patient" on hikes, and a strong jobs report the same day sent stocks surging.

events.label: Trade war escalates
events.why: The US said it would raise tariffs on Chinese goods to 25%, China retaliated, and stocks fell sharply.

events.label: Yuan breaks 7
events.why: As the US-China trade war escalated the yuan weakened past 7 per dollar; global risk assets and Treasury yields fell.

events.label: Treasury yield curve inverts
events.why: The 2-year and 10-year yields inverted, recession fears spread, and the S&P 500 fell about 3% in a day.

events.label: Saudi-Russia price war and the pandemic
events.why: Saudi Arabia launched a price war, oil fell about 25% in a day, and US stocks hit a circuit breaker for the first time.

events.label: Trump announces Europe travel ban
events.why: The US restricted entry from Europe and the S&P 500 fell about 9.5%, its worst day since 1987.

events.label: Stimulus hopes spark a huge rally
events.why: The Fed announced unlimited bond buying and Congress neared a roughly $2 trillion stimulus bill; the S&P 500 jumped about 9.4%.

events.label: Pfizer vaccine news
events.why: Pfizer said its vaccine was over 90% effective; money rotated out of stay-at-home stocks into cyclicals and oil rallied.

events.label: GameStop short squeeze
events.why: Retail traders piled into GameStop, hedge funds were forced to cover, and the VIX jumped in a day.

events.label: April CPI far above forecasts
events.why: Inflation came in well above expectations: stocks fell while Treasury yields and the VIX rose.

events.label: Fed dot plot turns hawkish
events.why: The Fed hinted at hikes in 2023; the dollar surged and gold and commodities slumped.

events.label: Evergrande crisis triggers selloff
events.why: Worries over China Evergrande's debt spread; the S&P 500 fell about 1.7% and the VIX jumped.

events.label: Omicron variant emerges
events.why: After Thanksgiving the WHO named Omicron, and oil fell more than 10% in a day.

events.label: Russia invades Ukraine
events.why: Oil topped $100 on the first day of the war, and stocks fell before rallying.

events.label: August CPI beats forecasts
events.why: Inflation came in hot, the S&P 500 fell about 4.3%, and the 2-year yield rose sharply.

events.label: UK "mini-budget" shock
events.why: The UK announced huge tax cuts, gilts crashed, and sterling neared parity with the dollar, rattling bond markets and the dollar worldwide.

events.label: October CPI below forecasts
events.why: Inflation came in cooler than expected: stocks surged while the dollar and Treasury yields fell together.

events.label: First trading day after SVB fails
events.why: Regulators seized Silicon Valley Bank and the 2-year yield plunged over two days as traders bet on rate cuts.

events.label: Fitch downgrades the US
events.why: Fitch cut the US from AAA to AA+; stocks fell and long-term yields rose.

events.label: October CPI below forecasts
events.why: Inflation cooled more than expected; stocks surged while the 10-year yield and the dollar dropped.

events.label: Weak jobs report
events.why: July payrolls badly missed forecasts, triggering Sahm Rule recession fears; stocks fell and yields plunged.

events.label: Yen carry trade unwinds
events.why: A Bank of Japan hike plus weak US jobs data sent the Nikkei down 12% and the VIX spiking intraday.

events.label: Trump wins again
events.why: Trump won the election; US stocks rallied while the dollar and Treasury yields rose.

events.label: Tariffs paused for 90 days
events.why: Trump paused the reciprocal tariffs and the S&P 500 jumped about 9.5% in a day.

events.label: US-China Geneva tariff truce
events.why: The US and China agreed to cut reciprocal tariffs sharply for 90 days; stocks surged and safe havens eased.

events.label: Trump threatens 100% China tariff
events.why: The US president announced new tariffs on Chinese goods; the S&P 500 fell about 2.7% and the VIX jumped.

events.label: Start of the crisis "Black Week"
events.why: The global banking crisis deepened, the Dow fell about 3.6% in a day, and the VIX broke above 50.

events.label: Fed cuts rates to 1%
events.why: The Fed lowered the federal funds rate to 1%, another cut during the financial crisis.

events.label: First COVID selloff day
events.why: An outbreak in Italy sent global stocks sharply lower on Monday, with Treasury yields and gold moving in step.

events.label: Fed gloom sparks "second bottom" fear
events.why: A cautious Fed outlook plus a rebound in US infections sent the S&P 500 down about 5.9% in a day.

events.label: Tech stock flash crash
events.why: The Nasdaq fell about 5% in a day, one of its worst drops since March 2020.

events.label: Second-wave worries in Europe and the US
events.why: Europe re-locked down and US cases surged; the S&P 500 fell about 3.5% and the VIX jumped.

events.label: Fed "hawkish cut"
events.why: The Fed cut rates but signaled fewer cuts in 2025; the S&P 500 fell about 3% and yields jumped.
